verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at event-driven automation. The pricing page lists "Webhook Events" and "Background workers", the homepage claims you can "extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow", and a community comment confirms background jobs run from a Bull queue. Nothing shows how a user defines rules that fire actions when events occur. missing for 10: documentation of an event subscriber or rule definition mechanism, examples of event-to-action configuration, a no-code or AI-driven rule builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.
